Thanks for the form and the clear questions, Alex. Short answers first: portal preferred; email allowed as fallback; see attached sample template for required fields.

Details / steps:
1) Preferred channel: Redwood vendor portal — it gives faster processing, automatic PO matching, and a confirmation receipt. URL and onboarding link are in the portal invite you'll receive after we finalize a couple of fields.

2) Email fallback: invoices can be sent to invoicing@redwood.com if you cannot access the portal. If you use email, please put the PO number in the subject line as: PO#12345 — that helps our automated parser.

3) Required template fields (attached: invoice_template_example.xlsx):
   - Invoice Number (unique)
   - Invoice Date (YYYY-MM-DD)
   - Supplier Name and Supplier Tax ID / EIN
   - Remit-To / Bank Details (or remit email)
   - Redwood PO Number (header) + line-level PO reference where applicable (SKU / line item number)
   - Line items: description, qty, unit price, line total, tax per line (if applicable)
   - Invoice total and currency

4) PO matching rules:
   - Primary: header PO# matches to Redwood PO and closes against receipt.
   - Secondary (recommended): include SKU or line-number to allow line-level matching. If no SKU, include a short description that maps to the PO line.

5) W-9 / tax docs: Upload the W-9 to the onboarding portal or attach it to the first invoice email. Put the tax ID in the Supplier Tax ID field in the template.

6) Attachments: please submit the vendor_onboarding_form.pdf you already sent, plus the W-9. I attached the invoice template to this message for a quick reference.

Edge cases / exceptions:
- If you plan to submit invoices via EDI/SFTP at scale, let us know — we can loop in infra.
- For single invoices while onboarding, use the email fallback and we'll process manually if needed.

Next steps:
- Fill out the invoice_template_example.xlsx for your next test invoice and either upload to the portal or send to invoicing@redwood.com with subject line containing the PO number.
- We'll confirm receipt and whether any fields need adjustment.

Best,

Hi Alex — quick confirmations from AP: 

- Remit details: please populate the Remit-To / Bank Details field in the template. If you prefer, you can also provide a separate bank detail attachment; we store both but the template field is used for automated processing.

- Portal receipts: yes — the portal sends an automated confirmation email within ~5 minutes of a successful upload. That email contains an internal tracking ID and the matched PO (if applicable).

- File naming convention (recommended): INV-{PO}-{YYYYMMDD}-{SupplierCode}.pdf (e.g., INV-12345-20260707-PROC.pdf). If you cannot name files like that, include the PO# in the subject line of the submission email.

Mutual action plan:
- Today: Complete invoice_template_example.xlsx with sample invoice numbers and upload to portal OR send to invoicing@redwood.com (subject includes PO#).
- Within 1 business day: Redwood AP confirms receipt and validates PO matching.
- By EOD next business day: If there are mapping issues, AP will flag exact fields to adjust.

If everything looks good after your test upload, we'll mark ProcureCo as a production supplier in our AP system and share our vendor code.

Thanks — looking forward to the test invoice.

Best,
